title: Understanding Full Column Rank
text: A matrix is full column rank if all its columns are linearly independent. This means no column can be written as a linear combination of the others.

title: Boolean Featurization
text: In the context of this problem, boolean featurization means representing the presence or absence of each food item with $$1$$ or $$0$$, respectively.

title: Analyzing the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix X has columns representing each food item. If a student eats a particular food, the corresponding column has a 1; otherwise, it has a $$0$$.

title: Checking for Linear Independence
text: Consider if any column in the design matrix can be expressed as a combination of the others. If not, the matrix is full column rank.

title: Conclusion on Full Column Rank
text: Based on the boolean featurization, can any column be expressed as a linear combination of the others?
